title: 避雷艾瑞森风r1
notes: Owner post (2026-09-09): STORM R1 tubeless front and rear both bulged by about 5,000 km; after the first bulge the owner had swapped the front for a clincher. Commenters reported bulges after 200-1,000 km (one said the maker declined warranty at 1,000 km) and air trapped between casing and rubber in a mid-2025 batch; one clincher rear sidewall cracked through at about 1,000 km, a CNY 160 clincher lasted 7,000 km with several punctures, and other clinchers had no problem at 1,000-2,000 km.
